text: Priya M: Quick copy check — inline CTA in the model list: the ellipsis menu currently shows 'Export tokens' and 'View usage'. 'Export tokens' is confusing (people think billing tokens). Can we rename? Screenshot attached. Liam K: I agree, 'Export tokens' is ambiguous. Prefer 'Download request logs' or 'Download logs'. Ava R: +1. Also note accessibility: the ellipsis button's aria-label is 'More options' but the menu items are still unclear to screen reader users. Proposal: menu label 'Download logs' and a visually-hidden description: 'Includes request/response JSON and timestamps'. Sam C: Implementation-wise the rename is trivial. For the SR description we can add aria-describedby. Example: Includes request, response and timestamps (JSON) Priya M: Good call. One localization concern: 'Download request logs' might be long in some languages. Is 'Download logs' enough? Ava R: Hmm. 'Download logs' is shorter but less specific. My suggestion: keep short primary label 'Download logs' and put the extra detail in the SR-only text and tooltip. Dan P: +1. Also we need copy for the empty state when there are no logs. Options: - 'No logs yet — make a request to see logs here.' - 'No activity yet. Send a request to start logging.' Liam K: I prefer 'No activity yet. Send a request to start logging.' Slightly friendlier. Ava R: I'll push a design PR with both variants and preferred spacing so FR/DE won't overflow. I'll also add the tooltip copy: 'Includes request & response (JSON)'. Sam C: I'll implement aria-label changes: ellipsis button -> 'More actions', menu item -> 'Download logs', tooltip -> 'Includes request & response (JSON)'. Will also wire up the visually-hidden desc. Priya M: Thanks! @Ava R can you update the design file and I'll mark this as done after the deploy? :thumbsup: Ava R: On it. cc @Liam K for localization checks. :sparkles:
